label: GO step after an unrewarded a2 trial (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively at GO (99.8% of mass; never at D1, ~0.2% at D2). Within GO it is gated by an unrewarded previous trial (90% of mass with prev_reward==0, zero activity when the reward input is 1) and by the previous choice being a2 (prev_action==1 holds only 1% of mass); it coincides with the model choosing a2 (model_act==2, 94% of mass, strongly negative choice logit), i.e. it is active when the agent repeats a2 after no reward. Activity decays over the episode and is ~zero after trial 80. Magnitude is largest over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 trials (top windows show activation ramping across 3-5 unrewarded a2 GO steps) and at higher value-head output. Predicate uses only observed history (ep_trial is a clock the agent could track); adding model_act==2 (the agent own upcoming choice) gives dev F1 0.54 vs 0.51-ish without. Precision is only ~0.45: many GO steps after unrewarded a2 are silent, with an episode-level/history-dependent modulation not captured.
